**Role Summary**
----------------

Direct Agents is running a growing fleet of AI-powered systems across our client and internal reporting stack — automated account agents, intelligence systems, always-on client dashboards — and is now building a new, confidential generative AI product for the media industry.

We're hiring a full-time, remote Full-Stack Developer to do both: help keep the existing fleet running and improving, and help build the new product from the ground up. A meaningful part of this job is working inside Claude Code as our primary engineering environment — steering and reviewing AI-generated code and agent workflows, not only writing everything by hand.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

Live systems you'll help support and extend:

* **Internal agent platform** — syncs and synthesizes account data, call transcripts, and performance signals across every client account, surfacing findings automatically
* **Client-facing report sites and dashboards** — hosted, JavaScript front ends backed by a SQL data layer and marketing-data pipelines, live for a dozen-plus client and internal audiences
* **Workflow automations** — connecting data sources, chat, and email/calendar tools so reporting and account data move without manual steps

Plus:

* **The confidential new product** — a from-scratch generative AI build for the media industry, where you'll help shape architecture and features from day one

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and maintain full-stack features across our Python/FastAPI backends, JavaScript front ends (Vue preferred), and SQL data layer
* Work inside Claude Code daily: prompt and steer agentic coding workflows, review AI-generated code and pull requests for correctness, and extend our library of custom skills and subagents
* Debug and harden the data pipelines (marketing-data extracts, SQL views, workflow automations) that feed client dashboards and internal agents
* Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, GPT) for generative features — copy generation, insight extraction, creative/image analysis — in both the existing systems and the new product
* Own deploys for live client-facing sites and internal tools, including monitoring, rollback, and incident response
* Collaborate with data, strategy, and account teams to translate reporting and media needs into working software
* Document systems, prompts, and workflows so institutional knowledge isn't locked in one person's head
* Contribute to architecture and feature decisions on the new confidential product alongside day-to-day support work

**Our Stack & Tools**
---------------------

* **Primary dev environment:** Claude Code — agentic coding, subagent workflows, custom skills. Comfort working AI-assisted (directing and reviewing agent output, not only typing every line by hand) is a core requirement for this role, not a bonus skill.
* **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQL (SQL Server / Azure SQL)
* **Frontend:** Vue.js (React or Angular experience also useful — several of our tools are React)
* **Data & pipelines:** marketing-data platforms, workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n), SQL databases
* **Deployment & infra:** Netlify, containerized cloud services, Git-based version control
* **AI:** Claude and GPT APIs, retrieval/vector search, agent orchestration patterns

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Proven full-stack development experience, with genuine interest or hands-on experience in AI-assisted or agentic development — not just calling an LLM API, but working inside tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar
* Solid backend skills in Python; front-end proficiency in JavaScript, Vue preferred
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, vector search, or media/marketing AI workflows is a strong plus
* Experience with RESTful APIs, Git-based version control, and agile workflows
* Comfortable owning both greenfield build work and ongoing support/maintenance of live, client-facing systems
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills — this role works directly with data, strategy, and account teams, not only engineering

new_jobs.description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

Direct Agents is running a growing fleet of AI-powered systems across our client and internal reporting stack — automated account agents, intelligence systems, always-on client dashboards — and is now building a new, confidential generative AI product for the media industry.

We're hiring a full-time, remote Full-Stack Developer to do both: help keep the existing fleet running and improving, and help build the new product from the ground up. A meaningful part of this job is working inside Claude Code as our primary engineering environment — steering and reviewing AI-generated code and agent workflows, not only writing everything by hand.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

Live systems you'll help support and extend:

* **Internal agent platform** — syncs and synthesizes account data, call transcripts, and performance signals across every client account, surfacing findings automatically
* **Client-facing report sites and dashboards** — hosted, JavaScript front ends backed by a SQL data layer and marketing-data pipelines, live for a dozen-plus client and internal audiences
* **Workflow automations** — connecting data sources, chat, and email/calendar tools so reporting and account data move without manual steps

Plus:

* **The confidential new product** — a from-scratch generative AI build for the media industry, where you'll help shape architecture and features from day one

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and maintain full-stack features across our Python/FastAPI backends, JavaScript front ends (Vue preferred), and SQL data layer
* Work inside Claude Code daily: prompt and steer agentic coding workflows, review AI-generated code and pull requests for correctness, and extend our library of custom skills and subagents
* Debug and harden the data pipelines (marketing-data extracts, SQL views, workflow automations) that feed client dashboards and internal agents
* Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, GPT) for generative features — copy generation, insight extraction, creative/image analysis — in both the existing systems and the new product
* Own deploys for live client-facing sites and internal tools, including monitoring, rollback, and incident response
* Collaborate with data, strategy, and account teams to translate reporting and media needs into working software
* Document systems, prompts, and workflows so institutional knowledge isn't locked in one person's head
* Contribute to architecture and feature decisions on the new confidential product alongside day-to-day support work

**Our Stack & Tools**
---------------------

* **Primary dev environment:** Claude Code — agentic coding, subagent workflows, custom skills. Comfort working AI-assisted (directing and reviewing agent output, not only typing every line by hand) is a core requirement for this role, not a bonus skill.
* **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQL (SQL Server / Azure SQL)
* **Frontend:** Vue.js (React or Angular experience also useful — several of our tools are React)
* **Data & pipelines:** marketing-data platforms, workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n), SQL databases
* **Deployment & infra:** Netlify, containerized cloud services, Git-based version control
* **AI:** Claude and GPT APIs, retrieval/vector search, agent orchestration patterns

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Proven full-stack development experience, with genuine interest or hands-on experience in AI-assisted or agentic development — not just calling an LLM API, but working inside tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar
* Solid backend skills in Python; front-end proficiency in JavaScript, Vue preferred
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, vector search, or media/marketing AI workflows is a strong plus
* Experience with RESTful APIs, Git-based version control, and agile workflows
* Comfortable owning both greenfield build work and ongoing support/maintenance of live, client-facing systems
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills — this role works directly with data, strategy, and account teams, not only engineering

Please be aware of fraudulent recruiters and scams. If you move forward in our recruitment process, you will only be contacted by the Direct Agents HR team. Questions? Email hrconcerns@directagents.com

**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team:**

Upstart’s Identity team builds the systems that help borrowers and lending partners securely access and manage their accounts across Upstart products. The team works at the intersection of product and security, reducing friction in the customer experience while protecting identity and customer data.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Identity team, you will build secure, reliable backend systems that power login, account management, authentication, and authorization experiences. You’ll own meaningful projects from design through delivery, partner across Product, Information Security, and Application Security, and help evolve how Upstart builds secure customer experiences at scale. This role is primarily backend focused; frontend experience is helpful but not required.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* Design, build, and operate backend systems that power secure login, account management, authentication, and authorization experiences across Upstart products.
* Own engineering projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement.
* Balance security requirements with customer experience, making thoughtful technical decisions that protect customer data while reducing unnecessary friction.
* Partner with Product, Information Security, Application Security, and engineering teams across Upstart to deliver secure capabilities and influence product direction.
* Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, maintainability, and security of interconnected systems and help establish effective engineering practices across the Identity domain.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate learning and delivery while applying engineering judgment and validating the resulting work.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus 4 years of software engineering experience.
* Experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining production backend software or services.
* Experience owning software engineering projects through multiple stages of the development lifecycle, from technical design through production delivery.
* Experience designing or integrating APIs, services, or other components within distributed or interconnected production systems.
* Experience applying software engineering practices including code review, automated testing, debugging, and production support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of identity and access management concepts and standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Experience working in a medium-to-large engineering organization or with systems spanning multiple engineering teams.
* Experience contributing to frontend development in addition to backend systems.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools in software engineering workflows.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar technical domains, communicate technical decisions and outcomes clearly, and develop deep expertise over time.

**Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

  

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

The mark of true success at Wave is the ability to be bold, learn quickly and share your knowledge generously.

Senior Software Engineers work in cross-functional teams alongside Engineers, Product Managers and Designers to bring their engineering skills to bear on exciting business challenges. They work collaboratively to solve tough problems in delivering world-class financial products to our customers at scale with a wide variety of technologies and help investigate new ones as we are constantly striving to keep our technology choices up to date.

* Writing clear, concise, elegant, and well-tested code.
* Working as part of a small, agile, integrated product team that’s focused on continual improvement of their skills and helping each other learn new things.
* Translating complex, cross-system challenges into well-defined execution plans.
* Delivering code that goes beyond what is strictly assigned.
* By taking responsibility for monitoring or alerts needed to support and maintain new initiatives post-launch
* Having a substantial impact on the entire team’s pace and quality of deliverables;

  + Through valuable technical insights into the work, e.g. creating a useful abstraction layer around multiple specific implementations or by applying advanced software design principles to a novel task.
  + Through their contributions, substantially reducing friction for the rest of the team, e.g. by delivering a particularly difficult and useful refactor.

* By working with external stakeholders to understand the end goals when required.
